title: Tech Deals Calendar: Black Friday, Prime Day & More
description: When gadgets are cheapest: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Prime Big Deal Days, Boxing Day and more, plus free tools to check a tech deal is genuinely a good price.
intro: We don’t post fake “deals”. Instead, here’s when gadget prices genuinely tend to drop, and how to check a deal is real before you buy.

image.alt: Person holding a blue and white product box

cardText: Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Prime Day and Boxing Day dates, plus how to check a deal is real.

blocks.title: Big sale dates
blocks.intro: Dates for the current season. Always confirm on the retailer’s own site.

items.title: Black Friday
items.text: The biggest tech sale of the year in the US, UK and Europe. Many stores start “Black Friday” offers in early November.

items.title: Cyber Monday
items.text: Online-focused deals the Monday after Black Friday; some stores run a full “Cyber Week”.

items.title: Singles’ Day
items.text: A huge shopping day in China that AliExpress and some Western retailers also join.

items.title: Boxing Day (UK)
items.text: Post-Christmas sales in the UK and some other countries, often running into January.

items.title: Amazon Prime Day
items.text: Amazon’s summer members’ sale; strongest discounts on Amazon’s own devices.

items.title: Prime Big Deal Days
items.text: Amazon’s October members’ event. It has finished for this year; many prices dip again for Black Friday.

items.title: Check the price history
items.text: Use camelcamelcamel or Keepa (Amazon), or PriceRunner and idealo in the UK and Europe.

items.title: Compare the exact model
items.text: Sales often feature older or retailer-specific models with similar names. Match the model number.

items.title: Check the seller
items.text: On marketplaces, check who is actually selling and shipping it, and their return policy.

items.title: Know your returns
items.text: UK and EU online buyers usually get 14 days to cancel. US returns depend on the store’s policy.

sections.h2: Which gadgets get the biggest discounts?
sections.html: Patterns repeat every year: Amazon’s own devices (Echo, Kindle, Fire TV, Ring) are discounted most heavily during Amazon events; robot vacuums, headphones, TVs and air fryers are Black Friday regulars; brand-new flagship phones and consoles rarely get big cash discounts, but bundles, gift cards and trade-in boosts are common.

In the EU, when a shop announces a price reduction it must show the lowest price it charged in the previous 30 days, so “was” prices can’t be inflated just before a sale. In the UK, the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) can act against misleading pricing. In the US, the FTC has guidance on deceptive former-price comparisons. Even so, a price tracker is the quickest reality check.

faqs.a: Black Friday 2026 is Friday 27 November, the day after US Thanksgiving (Thursday 26 November). Cyber Monday is 30 November 2026.

faqs.q: Is it better to buy tech on Black Friday or Cyber Monday?
faqs.a: There’s usually a lot of overlap: many deals run from Black Friday through Cyber Monday. Check price history on the item you want rather than waiting for a particular day.
